notes.title: Good News, Bad News
notes.content:
Hey folks!

As you may have noticed, I haven't posted in the community section, like... at all. I just sort of assumed that people forgot about this game.

That said, I'm really grateful that you've taken an interest in Three in a Rogue!

I have some bad news and good news...

The Bad News

This game isn't going to be finished. I contemplated describing this as a "hiatus" but I think just calling it "cancelled" is more honest and rips the band-aid off. I'll be looking into winding down this steam page in the near future.

The Good News

So although this game isn't going to be finished. There is a different, but similar game you can play right now, for free!

You may or may not know that Three in a Rogue is the sequel to a game jam game of the same name (hey that rhymed!). The game was originally made in 2 days, but then I spent another 2 months refining it. If you want a taste of what Three in a Rogue was supposed to be like, you should play it!

You can find it here:
http://notexplosive.net/three-in-a-rogue-classic


Thanks again and sorry for the bummer news.
NotExplosive


P.S:
Turns out you don't get notified when people post in your community section, even as the dev. I have to manually hit the "Subscribe to Forum" button on the right just like everybody else. Now I know that!
